title: FRM: Felix Runtime Module — papers and results
description:
Papers and results for FRM, the Felix Runtime Module, a bounded recursive self-improvement runtime tested as FELIX-C3 against a published Level-4 definition, together with a companion preregistered study of transfer to real bugs from QuixBugs and HumanEvalFix, and an earlier preprint on the FELIX v4 self-evolving organism.

Each release of this record archives the GitHub repository recurse-root/FRMDevelopment. To cite a paper, use that paper's own DOI, listed in the repository README.
